name: s81su_smq-s81su_smq-COMMIT
purpose: S81U-2: per-head SM tap leaf of the S81-DV regional service slice to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81_su_smq u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_dv/su_sm/ot_s81_su_smq.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81su_smq/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81su_smq/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81su_smq --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81_su_smq  > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81U-2 (S81-DV p4h, SM 1/16 per regional service slice): per-head softmax tap, successor of dsfd_su_t_smt (73x346 um, 5.4k pins on two faces, native capture FAIL 266/319 ps): one 512-b serial row port instead of the 2,560-b parameter tap, ~2.5k pins on four full faces of a 151x151 um square (<= 5.7 pins/um), flop-first pins, die hold budget (no input hold padding). g2 (DRC fix): the S-face clk pin had no pin range, so it landed inside the e_d run (x 75.6) and caused the one M3 Metal Spacing DRC (e_d[404] vs clk) in all three routes; clk now has its own range 92.88-93.6 with 0.72 um gaps to e_d (7.56-92.16, 6.05 pins/um as before) and o_vi.
